(c)	As informed to us, the company has availed term loan from Exim bank for its Ahmedabad Expansion Project and other Capex. Moreover, the company has initially funded all capex through its internal accruals. Post that company has taken disbursement of term loan in the form of reimbursement. Further during the year company has foreclosed it.

segment_mix.segment: The company is in the business of manufacturing and selling Auto rickshaws in domestic and overseas market and therefore, the company's business falls within a single business segment of manufacturing and selling Auto rickshaws only in accordance with IND AS 108 - Operating Segments.

timeline.summary: Shareholders approved **Dr. Kamalkishore C. Vora (DIN: 11166460)** as Independent Director via postal ballot on **April 17, 2026**, with 99.99% voting in favor.
Atul Auto entered into an MOU with Exponent Energy for the supply of 15,000 electric three-wheelers valued at ₹490.5 Cr.
Atul Auto partnered with Exponent Energy on April 24, 2026, to supply 15,000 rapid-charging electric three-wheelers over three years.
Atul Auto reported a 74% year-on-year jump in April 2026 total sales to 3,001 units.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹240.58 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹14.79 Cr.
Atul Auto reported a 29.34% YoY increase in May 2026 total sales to 3,236 units.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹268.31 Cr (+34.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹6.69 Cr (-27.0% YoY).
